method: Inductive bounds from actual reset/assignment/guard sites, supplemented by real RTL shadow consumer checks and actual checksum extreme/rejection executions. No mirrored Python test is used as evidence of RTL equivalence.

checksum.induction: DECODE macro4 resets to zero; each TRANSFORM adds 15-digit for digit in0..15; exactly LEN1 iterations, so all partial sums0..15*LEN1<=960. Bits11:10 remain zero.
checksum.first_digit: Original {1b0,checksum[11:8]} equals new {3b0,checksum[9:8]} because bits11:10 remain zero.

transform_index.induction: Initialized0 at macro4; only incremented when index+1 != LEN1; LEN1 in32/48/64. The equality is evaluated before assignment truncation, so no valid wrap occurs.

pipe_next_chain.induction: Reset0 or assigned chain_cursor at validated batch setup; accepted requests require next<endpoint_count; increment can reach endpoint_count<=67, after which no further request is admitted.

pipe_completed.induction: Reset0 for batch; each allocated tag can retire once; terminal response transitions out of pipe mode when completed+1>=endpoint_count. At most endpoint_count<=67 returns exist.

pipe_chain_index.induction: Stores pre-increment next_chain only on selected&&ready, which requires next<endpoint_count<=67; per-tag entry is not consumed before allocation and not overwritten until return.

same_cycle_issue_return: Existing ordered nonblocking updates retire before reallocation. Counters increase independently; old shadow stores the pre-increment8-bit index into each issued tag, checks actual batch address and successful endpoint writeback.

invalid_endpoint_counts.guard: CHAIN_SETUP: endpoint_count==0 || endpoint_count>67, before pipe/cache setup and issue states
invalid_endpoint_counts.scope_correction: Accepted standard chain-count interval is1..67;0 is rejected.

integer_arithmetic: No changed shift expression. Unsized +1/PIPELINE comparisons retain at least32-bit width; assignment truncation is harmless under bounds. The checksum arithmetic width shrinks from12 to10 but960 maximum fits and the per-digit subtraction never makes the accumulated final expression negative.
scope: Canonical standard12 ROMs, valid node sizes, normal reset/handshake behavior; no X/Z or arbitrary forced malformed-state equivalence claimed.
